GET the page with Referer https://oldrepublictitle.com/rate-calculator/?location=virginia (capture __VIEWSTATE/__EVENTVALIDATION), POST __EVENTTARGET=ddlPolicyCategory value 5 (SIMULTANEOUS LOAN & OWNERS), POST __EVENTTARGET=ddlPolicyType1 value 11900 (OWNER - BASIC), POST __EVENTTARGET=ddlPolicyType2 value 11908 (LOAN - BASIC), then POST __EVENTTARGET=btnCalculate with txtLiabilityAmt=500000, txtCrLiabilityAmt=400000. scenario: $500,000 purchase price / $400,000 loan amount, statewide (no county selector in this tool), SIMULTANEOUS LOAN & OWNERS BASIC policy category.
methodology: Direct HTTP GET/POST against the ASP.NET WebForms postback mechanism (Python requests.Session()), no browser/JS execution. No personal data entered. Richness pass applying this project's already-solved Old Republic 2nd-tool recipe to a state that had already crossed the 3-provider calculator-quoted threshold via other providers.
